description: This file defines the CordzHandle class and its subclass CordzSnapshot, which manage handle objects used for profiling and safe deletion in the Abseil library's internal string handling components. It includes mechanisms for safe deletion, diagnostics, and thread safety within a delete queue.

classes.name: CordzHandle
classes.description: A handle class used for managing objects in a delete queue with thread safety and snapshot capabilities.

classes.name: CordzSnapshot
classes.description: A subclass of CordzHandle representing a snapshot handle for safe inspection.

methods.name: is_snapshot
methods.description: Checks if the handle is a snapshot.

methods.name: SafeToDelete
methods.description: Determines if the handle is safe to be deleted.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Static method to delete or enqueue a handle for deletion.

methods.name: DiagnosticsGetDeleteQueue
methods.description: Returns current delete queue entries in LIFO order.

methods.name: DiagnosticsHandleIsSafeToInspect
methods.description: Checks if a handle is safe to inspect.

methods.name: DiagnosticsGetSafeToInspectDeletedHandles
methods.description: Returns handles protected by this handle that are safe to inspect.

methods.name: CordzHandle
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handle, possibly as a snapshot.

methods.name: ODRCheck
methods.description: Performs a check for ODR violations.
